> The guide's own use of this number: it plays on teams with a Stability Score edge of 6 or more in non-conference games in weeks 0–3, and against teams scoring 0–6 in the same window, excluding games with a spread of 30 or more (pp. 40–41).

## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 32. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke frames the hire as a cleanup job: Sherrone Moore's ugly departure from Ann Arbor on the heels of Jim Harbaugh's tainted national championship created the need for a well-respected, accomplished football lifer. He notes this is the first time since Whittingham was defensive coordinator at Idaho State in 1992-93 that he calls somewhere other than Salt Lake City home. He then states his own position directly — Whittingham has long been viewed as one of the game's elite coaches, both against the spread and in terms of maximizing talent, and his Utah teams were always tough to face because of their presence in the trenches — before adding that he is skeptical of the 66-year-old entering the Big Ten and a programme with extreme expectations.
